strings.cachelimit_info: Enter the maximum size of files (in bytes) to be cached on server for Dropbox aliases/shortcuts. Cached files will be served when the source is no longer available. Empty value or zero mean caching of all files regardless of size.
strings.issuer_help: Select the OAuth 2 service that is configured to talk to the Dropbox API. If the service doesn't exist yet, you will need to create it.
strings.privacy:metadata:repository_dropbox: The Dropbox repository plugin does not store any personal data, but does transmit user data from Moodle to the remote system.
strings.privacy:metadata:repository_dropbox:quer: The Dropbox repository user search text query.
